name: codynd
description: ND-friendly mods for Claude Code: patch status line and friends.

chaospatchServer.title: ChaosPatch MCP server
chaospatchServer.description: The ChaosPatch server's name as /mcp lists it.

projectAliases.title: ChaosPatch project aliases
projectAliases.description: For repos whose folder name doesn't match their ChaosPatch project: folder=slug pairs, comma-separated (e.g. ADHD-AgenticDevHumanDesigns=adhdesigns).

doneChimeSound.title: Done chime sound
doneChimeSound.description: Play a chime when a ChaosPatch patch is completed or sent to review.

attentionChimeSound.title: Attention chime sound
attentionChimeSound.description: Play a short chime when Claude needs you: a permission prompt or a question.

landingChimeSound.title: Landing chime sound
landingChimeSound.description: Play a cabin chime with the 15-minute heads-up before your next ControlledChaos event.

soundtrackPlaylist.title: Soundtrack playlist
soundtrackPlaylist.description: What /soundtrack plays when a patch starts: a spotify: URI or an open.spotify.com link.

soundtrackFadeOnDone.title: Soundtrack fade on done
soundtrackFadeOnDone.description: Fade out and pause the soundtrack's music when a patch is completed.

bodyCheckMinutes.title: Body check interval (minutes)
bodyCheckMinutes.description: Minutes of continuous work before a gentle body-check nudge.

kindlingServer.title: Kindling MCP server
kindlingServer.description: The Kindling server's name as /mcp lists it (for /park).

controlledChaosServer.title: ControlledChaos MCP server
controlledChaosServer.description: The ControlledChaos server's name as /mcp lists it (for the next-event countdown).
